scoring_justification: The headline transition pressure and volume change are computed from full static lattice energy minimizations and equation-of-state fitting that cannot be re-run in the verifier sandbox; the checker compares the agent's reported values against the paper's hidden gold with tolerances and structural ordering checks.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold transition pressures and relative volume changes for CIM-DQ and CIM no-polarization models, as reported in Table III of the paper.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Table III of the published paper (see paper markdown in context).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper's Table III: 'CIM, no polarization' Pt 18 GPa, ΔV -3.57%; 'CIM-DQ' Pt 194 GPa, ΔV -1.68%.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact reported values the agent is supposed to reproduce via the described simulation procedure.

outputs.description: A JSON array with two entries, one for each model variant ("CIM-DQ" and "CIM no polarization"). Each entry reports the calculated corundum→Rh₂O₃-II transition pressure (Pt_GPa) and relative volume change (delta_V_percent). The checker will apply threshold_or_better tolerances on Pt and delta_V, as well as a secondary structural ordering check.
